name: Weapon of Energy
body:
Discipline Psychokinesis [see text]; Level Psychic warrior 4

MANIFESTING

Display Visual

EFFECT

Range Touch
Target Weapon touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (object, harmless); Power Resistance None
Power Points 7

DESCRIPTION

As claw of energy, except this power can be manifested on a touched weapon. This power’s subtype is the same as the type of energy infused in the touched weapon.
